name: smwpatches-walking-monty-mole
title: Walking Monty Mole
description:
This patch allows for a monty mole to be placed in its walking state instead of digging out. To do that, place sprite 12 (originally unused).

Its behavior (follow or walk with a hop) will still be dependent on its X position, unless the Sprite Properties Depending on the Extra Bit patch has been installed, in which case it will similarly obey the extra bit.
